result.instructions: Northbridge Cycles' Ledgerline ERP, as PSHAH. One tool per business activity.

ledgerline/policy.on_busy_or_lost_reply: retry the read, at most 2 more times
ledgerline/policy.after_retries: ok=false, ledgerline_code ERR-SYS-0503 or TIMEOUT, with next_step

tools.description: Why a supplier invoice is on hold: each open hold and what is wrong, who may release it, and the last Friday run that still pays it by the due date. Give the number printed on the invoice (e.g. 4471) or Ledgerline's AP number; if two suppliers match, ask which.

invoice_no.description: the number on the supplier's invoice, e.g. 4471, or Ledgerline's own number, e.g. AP/2026/03390

supplier.description: part of the supplier's name, e.g. Voltway Cells; needed when two suppliers used the same number

tools.name: explain_hold

ok.description: true when it worked; false comes with error and next_step

supplier.description: the supplier's name as Ledgerline has it, e.g. Voltway Cells Pvt. Ltd.

ap_no.description: Ledgerline's own number for the invoice, e.g. AP/2026/03390; use it in any later call

invoice_no.description: the number printed on the supplier's invoice, e.g. 4471

due_date.description: YYYY-MM-DD; Ledgerline works it out from the invoice date and the supplier's payment terms

payment.description: when the invoice can be paid; null when it is already paid, rejected or cancelled

last_run.description: the last Friday run on or before the due date (YYYY-MM-DD)

cutoff.description: the Thursday before last_run; every hold must be released and the payment approved by then

why_not.description: the reason when payable_this_friday is false, e.g. on hold, or early and needs the financial controller

holds.description: every open hold on the invoice, oldest first; empty when the invoice is not on hold

code.description: H-PRC price, H-QTY quantity, H-GRN no goods receipt, H-DUP looks like a duplicate

what_is_wrong.description: the gap in words, e.g. 18,000 billed, 17,700 accepted

may_release.description: the people allowed to release this hold, from AP policy 4.1

matches.description: only when the number matches invoices from more than one supplier; then holds and payment are left out

error.description: what went wrong, only when ok is false

next_step.description: what to do next: ask which supplier (with matches), or how to recover (with error)

ledgerline_code.description: Ledgerline's own error code, e.g. ERR-AP-0001 or ERR-SYS-0503; empty when the tool itself refused

tools.title: Explain hold
